Interface IBindingDefinitionModel

All Superinterfaces:
IAttributable, IBindingModelElement, IContainer, IDefaultable, IDefinition, IDescribable, IFeatureValueConstrained, IJsonNamed, IModelDefinition, IModelElement, IModelElementVisitable, INamed, INamedModelElement, IValueConstrained

IBindingDefinitionModelAssembly
public interface IBindingDefinitionModel extends IModelDefinition, IBindingModelElement
Represents a Metaschema model definition loaded via data binding.

This interface provides access to the binding-specific metadata for field and assembly definitions.
